exposure: Ropivacaine combined with sufentanil for epidural labor analgesia
Ropivacaine alone for epidural labor analgesia
outcome: Visual Analogue Scale (VAS) score at 5 min, 30 min, 60 min, and 90 min after analgesia
Rates of conversion to cesarean section
Apgar scores at 1 and 5 min after birth
finding: Ropivacaine combined with sufentanil for epidural labor analgesia in painless labor can effectively relieve labor pain, improve lactation function, active the first stage of labor, shorten the time of labor, reduce the incidence of cesarean section and ensure the safety of mother and infant.
mod_finding: There were significant differences in the rates of conversion to cesarean section and usage rate of forceps between the two groups.
